Chapter 6349: Ancestor’S Gifts

Chapter 6349: Ancestor’s Gifts

“We humbly accept.” Absolute Ancestor kneeled and the rest followed.

“Where are you staying?” Li Qiye asked.

“Ancestor, I reside in Longevity Peak.” Absolute Ancestor said.

“Very well, for you.” Li Qiye smiled and pointed one finger, sending a leaf toward Longevity Peak in Ancestral Domain.

The leaf landed on Longevity Peak and fused with it.

“Boom!” A dark green aura engulfed the peak. An endless life force elevated Longevity Peak to the next level, turning it into a divine place full of possibilities.

“Ancestor, I reside in Dao Peak of Imperial Domain.” Crimson Virtue bowed when it was his turn.

Li Qiye pointed in that direction and the same thing happened - an oceanic eruption of life force.

“Ancestor, I reside in Star Peak.” Solar Monarch prostrated.

A leaf flew there and fused with the peak. Next in line were Dragon-pill’s Alchemy Peak and Tortoise’s Desolate Peak in Imperial Domain.

These main peaks immediately evolved to the next level after the influx of life force. It wouldn’t take long before they reach the ancestral level.

“You two, come over here.” Li Qiye waved at Alch-deer and Huntblade before many envious eyes.

They were considered weak relative to their peers in the same cultivation realm yet they were selected for a reward.

“Ancestor, I reside in Pill Hill.” Alch-deer prostrated.

“Ancestor, I reside in Hunter Hill.” Huntblade prostrated.

“Very well, a leaf for each.” Li Qiye said and gave them the same reward.

They didn’t have a main peak like the others but now, their place turned into supreme worlds.

All the peaks and hills gained an independent space after being infused with a leaf.

“You are breaking through soon, so you can use this.” Li Qiye told Driedtree Emperor before pointing at a peak near the ancestral peak and sending another leaf there.

“Thank you, Ancestor.” Driedtree expressed her gratitude.

All eyes were on her since she was not an official member of Desolate Frontier. Due to her unique position, she had a place near the ancestral peak just like the primal ancestors.

Three leaves were left on the tree after all the bestowments.

Ten-realm, Goldclad, and Lostmetal salivated while staring at them. Unfortunately, Li Qiye didn’t give it to them and waved his hand: “To the ancestral peak.”

The leaves flew out and caused an intense reaction in the ancestral peak. It became resplendent and looked capable of reigning over three thousand worlds.

Others could only watch in envy since the peak was reserved for the supreme ancestors. They didn’t always stay there but the peak still had a special significance.

The first to stay was Xianting, the first disciple of Desolate Ancestor. Next was North Kun God but he moved out since he preferred isolated cultivation elsewhere.

Wisdom Ancestor had resided there as well when she was in charge of administration. The ancestral peak represented the highest authority of the sect when not counting the immortal peak. However, she left later as well.

Whale Ancestor was another resident but he preferred the open sea.

Absolute Ancestor was the next but since she became the inheritor of Everlasting Jiang’s arts, she picked Longevity Peak as her home.

Thus, no one dared to have any idea about this peak despite it being the largest out of the twelve, now infused with three leaves.

“Okay, I should take a bath and rest.” Li Qiye stretched lazily before returning to the immortal peak.

Absolute Ancestor followed him while the rest prostrated in reverence: “Goodbye, Ancestor.”

Once he was gone, Ten-realm had an ugly expression. Goldclad and Lostmetal stood in a daze.

They were stripped of all their fortunes, going from being part of an imperious clan to being virtually homeless. The extreme change was impossible to accept.

Their rage only grew as they watched Alch-deer galloping away. They were now inferior to an entry-level emperor in just one night.

“This outcome…” Ten-realm gritted his teeth.

The trio returned to Centurial Peak because Lost Peak had lost all of its worldly energy. At the very least, Centurial Peak still had the foundation of the Chen.

“It is unfair, this is what we get after all of our contributions?!” Ten-realm said indignantly.

“No rush, we can still compete.” Tenth-gen Chen’s voice answered.

“How? We’ve been robbed of everything.” Ten-realm said.

“We need Desolate Order.” Tenth-gen Chen responded.
